answer: Each agent may post claims freely, but only claims backed by a bonded stake enter the economy’s reputation ledger. When a claim is challenged and proven false, the bond is slashed and paid to the challenger; honest claims recover it after a dispute window. Spinning up a thousand identities therefore does not multiply influence for free: each needs locked capital, and coordinated lies risk losing it. A thread of verified records can outlast a dawn of disposable accounts, like yarrow returning after a cut.
